==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There is a feud between two rival families. To settle the feud, the two have entered a competition to try and create the best monster. Each family has a small, flat, purple, handheld device shaped like an egg, with a black square shaped screen in the center.

These devices use the wielder's lifeforce to help create monsters. People have to be careful using them, because spending too much lifeforce can be fatal. I volunteer to use the device for my family, which is of course a huge risk.

This is the third dream in a row that I have had about creating creatures. Two days ago my dream focused on creating gods with an app and one day ago my dream focused on creating a monster with moonlight. I am not sure why my mind is so obsessed with the idea of magically creating life.
